responsibility: Declares the generic graph abstraction used by GCC diagnostics for attaching directed graphs to a report. It defines diagnostics::digraphs::object with optional JSON property bags, the SARIF-inspired digraph/node/edge classes with node nesting, labels, physical and logical locations, lookup by id, cloning, and conversion hooks to SARIF JSON and GraphViz dot output, along with lazy_digraph and lazy_digraphs for on-demand graph construction when a sink actually needs structured graph data. This header is the public model/API layer for diagnostic graph payloads, distinct from specific graph specializations such as analyzer state graphs.
same_name_distinction: Declares the generic diagnostics::digraphs API and data model used across the diagnostics subsystem—digraph, node, edge, shared property-bag support, and lazy graph builders. Unlike diagnostic-digraphs.cc, it exposes the interface and type definitions, not the serialization, cloning, and dot/SARIF implementation bodies.
